hurried: limit app w 3 lights for spending pls
fuller: Three lights going green, amber, red as today's spend nears my daily limit, plus a big total and an add form.

hurried: plant thing that tells me which ones are thirsty
fuller: For a busy mom with lots of plants: a name-sorted list, a Watered button on each, and a Need water count.

hurried: night diary that counts nights in a row
fuller: 21:30 every day a reminder comes to write in my diary. The app counts how many nights in a row I have written, with a long-text entry box and a list by day.

hurried: how many days till my exam and how far along i am
fuller: A bar that fills up as the exam gets nearer, with days, hours and minutes left under it. I set the exam date and time and when I started studying.

hurried: log exam marks and see the average
fuller: For anyone tracking school exams, list each subject with marks got out of the total. Show the percent for each one. Add an average at the bottom.

hurried: homwork due dates remind me on each deadline
fuller: I keep missing deadlines, so show open work by due date, tick it off, and remind me on each due day.

hurried: sleep clock bedtime wake circle
fuller: 23:00 bedtime and 7:00 wake-up, shown as arcs on a circle that I can change, with both times written beside it.

hurried: where my money goes by month pls
fuller: I want to see where my money goes each month. Please include: a list of spending by day, a total for the month, bars by category, arrows to move between months.

hurried: app where i tap a glass to count my water
fuller: A row of glasses on the main page, and tapping one adds a glass. The number reads like 3 of 8 glasses, and there is an Undo button too, with the goal open to change.

hurried: school fees for each kid per term
fuller: Each child has a section with the fee paid for Term 1, Term 2 and Term 3, and a Paid in total line. I can add a child and a fee on the same page.

hurried: craft stock counter with low warning
fuller: A form to add a craft item, a list sorted by quantity with plus and minus buttons, and a count of items running low, because I keep running out of thread and glue.

hurried: rain log, totals for today and this week
fuller: Totals for today and this week, a heat map of the last 70 days, and quick 5, 10, 25 mm buttons.

hurried: savings app where i add each deposit i make
fuller: I keep forgetting how much I have saved, so list every deposit I add, with a form on top.

hurried: pool game app that counts points for dad and son
fuller: Two buttons per side, +1 and +10, plus a Lead line for the gap. A Dad win or Son win message shows when someone reaches the Play to number, which starts at 7.

hurried: mileage claim total per month
fuller: A list of trips by day that I can tap to edit or swipe away. Above it, Claim this month at 25 per km to start, plus a km total and bars by purpose.

hurried: chess club score board for zain and omar pls
fuller: 1 point per tap, so Zain and Omar can keep score every game without argument, with an Undo button and a New game button to reset.

hurried: reading time app that counts minutes toward a daily goal
fuller: A heat map of the last 70 days shows each day's minutes, with a 7:30 reminder daily.

hurried: flash cards app with a draw a card button
fuller: Add a card with a form. Then tap a card to flip it between front and back. A Draw a card button picks one at random.

hurried: pet weight log w a 9pm reminder pls
fuller: Two pages, Add a weight in kg and Charts by day, with a 9pm reminder for the pet.

hurried: does it show my weekly workout percent?
fuller: Reminders at 8:00 and 20:00 every day to tick off my workouts. Each move gets a tick box, and the page shows percent done this week and over the last 30 days.

hurried: flashcards w got it and again buttons pls
fuller: Each card shows its front, and a tap flips it to the back, with a count of cards still to learn. Got it raises a card's level and Again resets it to zero.

hurried: pages read log w quick buttons pls
fuller: One-tap buttons for 5, 10 or 20 pages, and a bar chart of the last 7 days, because I want to see my reading build up each day without typing numbers.

hurried: app to see who owes me money and what is late
fuller: 1 total owed to me at the bottom, so I stop chasing money from memory: each client lists unpaid orders with a due date and a late label.

hurried: tasks in four boxes urgent important both neither
fuller: For a planner juggling a lot, here are tasks in a 2 by 2 grid. Urgent, Important, Both and Neither each get a box. Use Move to edit a task and Done to remove it.

hurried: can it help me wait before buying stuff?
fuller: At the top, a Money saved by not buying total and a Wait 24 hours before you decide note. Each thing I want shows a price with Still want it and Skip it buttons.

hurried: calorie count today with quick add buttons
fuller: A History list of every bite with its calories, which I can tap to fix or swipe away, because I want to see where the day's calories went.

hurried: how much will i get paid this month?
fuller: 400 an hour to start, and 1.5 times that for overtime. The Pay this month figure updates as I add shifts. Use the Overtime 2h button for extra time.

hurried: walk steps app with a heat map
fuller: A heat map of my steps for the last 70 days, with one-tap buttons for 1000, 2000 or 5000 steps.

hurried: dream diary with vivid score 1 to 5
fuller: A list of my dreams to tap and edit, each with a title, a long story and a vivid rating from 1 to 5.

hurried: what's open on my office task list?
fuller: I keep losing track of work, so open tasks come first, highest priority at the top.

hurried: sewing orders with thread colour
fuller: I keep mixing up orders, so I want: a list sorted by due date, each order showing customer, item, thread colour and due date, plus a form to add one.

hurried: birthdays and anniversaries list with days left to go
fuller: 2 kinds of day, Birthday and Anniversary, with a days-left count for each name, so I never miss one, plus a reminder on the day.

hurried: seting chart for 20 desks w names
fuller: A grid of 20 desks in five columns with the name of who sits at each, and a count of empty desks.

hurried: game time chart per day and this wek total
fuller: A bar chart of game time for the last 7 days, Today and This week totals, and a list of plays to tap and fix.

hurried: water glass counter with undo btn
fuller: I forget to drink water all day, so a glass drawing I tap to add one, with the count out of 8 glasses and an Undo button for a mis-tap.

hurried: does the fridge list warn me what runs out?
fuller: For anyone with a fridge, a list of food sorted by how little is left. Each item shows its kind and expiry date with minus and plus buttons. Items running low are counted at the top.

hurried: rent tracker pls who paid this month
fuller: Rent for my flats is hard to keep straight. Please include: Got rent buttons for unpaid tenants, the due day beside each name, a collected figure with a progress bar, and tenants sorted by due day.

hurried: vendor budget left to pay pls
fuller: For a planner with many vendors, each one shows what I agreed to pay and what I have paid. A bar under each name shows how far along it is. The Still to pay total sits at the top.

hurried: clock app for bedtime and wake up time on a circle
fuller: I sleep badly and need a clearer view. Please include: a circle with arcs for bedtime and wake-up, both times as text, and settings to change each time.

hurried: how many days since my last walk?
fuller: I want to stay active, so show days since my last walk, my day streak and walks this week.

hurried: meal skip log with weekly limit
fuller: I skip meals too often, so a Log skipped meal button and a progress bar against my weekly limit of 3. Reminders at 8:00 and 20:00 every day help too.

hurried: hobby spending this month total
fuller: My hobby money needs these: Spent this month at the top, a form to add a cost, and a list by day that I can tap or swipe, plus a daily reminder at 8:00 and 20:00.

hurried: reading streak pls with goal mins
fuller: For someone reading each night, a goal of 20 minutes. It shows my streak in days, my best streak and a bar chart of the last 7 days. Quick buttons add 10, 20 or 30 minutes at a tap.

hurried: books i read this year count vs my goal
fuller: I want to hit my target, so show books finished out of a goal of 20 with a progress bar, and books left.

hurried: sleep log app that shows average hours
fuller: 8 hours is the goal, shown with a bar for last night and an average. A 14-day bar chart and a form add each night.

hurried: goals scord counter tap to add a goal
fuller: A drawing of circles that I tap to add each goal, a Target reached notice when I hit the target, and an Undo button.

hurried: app to log pages read and see a 7 day chart
fuller: For a reader building a habit, I just add pages as I go. The total pages today sits in a big number at the top. A bar chart shows the last 7 days.

hurried: study timer log with weekly goal
fuller: 840 minutes is my weekly goal, shown with a progress bar and a History list to tap or swipe.

hurried: eating out spend vs monthly budget pls
fuller: Safe to spend a day, split from what is left of my monthly budget, with arrows to change months.

hurried: penalty score tracker team a vs b
fuller: Two rows of five circles, four buttons for A and B scoring or missing, and a score line between the teams.
